name: Sequoia Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Sequoia Capital (sequoiacap.com), the Menlo Park venture firm founded in 1972, whose site is operated by Sequoia Capital Operations, LLC and whose Arc programme and seed funds are announced on sequoiacap.com; Form D filings for its US/E seed and venture vehicles list Menlo Park, CA. This file covers the U.S./Europe firm and its seed and early practice (Arc, Seed Funds IV-VI, the 2025 Series A fund). Not Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA) and not HongShan / HSG (formerly Sequoia China): both separated in 2023 (TechCrunch, 2025) and are separate firms; their funds (e.g. Sequoia Capital India Seed Fund II, Sequoia Capital China Seed Fund III on EDGAR) and their deals (e.g. HSG's co-lead of Pragmatik Labs) are excluded. Not Sequoia Global Equities (the firm's public-markets arm) and not unrelated 'Sequoia' fund managers (e.g. the Sequoia Fund mutual fund).

open_items: Scout Seed Fund III ($180M, announced January 2018): exact close date not stated; the date recorded is Sequoia's 16 January 2018 post saying the fund had been raised. Seed Funds I (2012) and II (2013) are mentioned by Crunchbase News without sizes and are not recorded.
Not to be confused with 'Sequoia Capital India Seed Fund II Ltd.' (EDGAR Form D 2021-02-23, Ebene, Mauritius), a Peak XV-lineage seed fund with a similar 2021 timing: excluded.

Fund sizes could not be read from SEC Form D documents: sec.gov refused the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent for filing documents (efts full-text search worked), so only fund names, filing dates and Menlo Park location were taken from EDGAR.
Venture Fund XVIII (2022) size and close date not found; only partners/principals vehicles appear on EDGAR. TechCrunch says the 2025 funds 'nearly match the sizes launched about three years ago'.
Venture Fund XIX vs EDGAR: EDGAR shows 'Sequoia Capital Venture Partners Fund XIX' and 'Seed Partners Fund VI' (Form D 2026-03-13); final closes beyond the October 2025 launch announcement not found.
portfolio_count_reported: no portfolio count stated on sequoiacap.com (the site lists company pages but gives no total).
invests_in_indian_founders: not stated. The 2025 fund post says it seeks founders 'from around the globe'; Sequoia's former India business is now Peak XV Partners (separate file).

application_url: sequoiacap.com/arc describes the open call but shows no form or dates; sequoiacap.com/arc/apply is listed in the site map but rendered no visible content when fetched (likely a JavaScript form or a closed call). Arc application windows for 2026 not found.
Co-investors not named on Sequoia's posts for Auctor, Probook, Sable, Pace, Air, Cymphony, Catalyst, Preview and Scanner; amounts for those rounds not stated.
Ricursive Intelligence: $750M (seed) and $4B (Series A) valuations reported without a pre/post-money label, so left null; company website not confirmed.

Seed rounds of Sable, Probook, Air, Cymphony, Auctor (YC graduate) and Rox were led or joined by Sequoia, but their seed dates/amounts are not stated on the pages read, so only the later Series A is recorded.

Not recorded as outside seed/Series A scope or stage unstated: Mecka AI (Sequoia-led $60M Series B, Oct 2026, per search results, not fetched), Empirik ($21M, stage not stated, Sep 2026), Sunflower Labs (drones, round stage not stated, Nov 2025), NUVACORE (CPU core, pre-seed/seed 2026, listed only on Liam Corrigan's profile), Traversal (Sequoia-led seed announced with a Kleiner-led Series A, $48M combined, June 2025).

Partner titles are not shown on sequoiacap.com profiles; 'Partner' is taken from the 2023/2025 fund posts ('Sequoia partners on the Early team') and press linked on profiles. Liam Corrigan's title not found. Roelof Botha, Bryan Schreier and Charlie Curnin authored 2025-2026 seed/Series A posts (Flow, Sunflower Labs, Gridware, Pace) but have no profile page on the current site.
